summary: The table presents employee statistics for three quarters ending on December 31, 2024, September 30, 2024, and December 31, 2023. It includes metrics such as total employees, software professionals, sales and support staff, voluntary attrition percentage in IT services, and the percentage of women employees. Notable trends include a slight increase in total employees and software professionals from September 2024 to December 2024, while the voluntary attrition rate remained stable at 12.9% in the last two quarters. The percentage of women employees showed a minor increase from 39.0% to 39.3% over the same period.
table_rows: Voluntary Attrition % (LTM - IT Services): Dec 31 2024 = 13.7%, Sep 30 2024 = 12.9%, Dec 31 2023 = 12.9%
